dedupe_keys.name: supporting decision making for industrial symbioses using a hybrid modelling approach and its application to wastewater treatment

description: The researchers implement a hybrid model of collective olive-mill wastewater treatment. Agent-based simulation represents stakeholder behaviour, discrete-event simulation represents operational processes, system dynamics represents evolving interactions, and multicriteria decision analysis represents stakeholder perspectives. The application addresses dispersed small mills, seasonal discharge and high organic loading. A separate supplement describes a decision questionnaire, implementation materials and a STRESS modelling checklist. These source-described model components establish an actual wastewater decision model, without proving public executable code, numerical validation results or operational adoption. The related mobile-rental model shares a methodological family, but its different service scenario remains distinct. The source documents a water quality treatment or recovery study. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap. Document access and licensing do not establish executable availability or software rights.
